body:
# PYAT S01/S02 / PP26-01,02,05,06 — ACTIVATE CURRENT, COMPETENT ORIGINAL35 SOURCE/SCIENTIFIC FIRST-READ RIGHTS
**MODE:** existing competent source/measurement/issuer owner with Codex local machine assistance; program originals S01 S02, NOT new science standards or new R3 packet. This is the independently owned native-source lane parallel to sourcefree [#997](https://github.com/maidiu/rawlsing/issues/997) and [#998](https://github.com/maidiu/rawlsing/issues/998). **DO NOT infer respondent-data license or current host/purpose permission from user saying "GO" to sourcefree engineering**. This commission authorizes exact verification and eligible execution **only under existing authenticated current source/issuer rights**, otherwise finite decision/hold.

## Existing exact conserved capital
R157 source library/config, original35 physical roster (35 sources; historical 18,276 items / 18,413 slots; 26 unresolved matches), P01–P20/T01–T18 source equivalence, U_item/U_unit/U_app/E_pre source-science/claim compiler; existing partial original SRC04/SRC17 positives are **dated evidence**, not automatic new permitted source reads. S1-B `dedd2fb8a1f5842910a0dc842fe75b3618c23443`, S1-C `dae66cdf9f3846d237e0b1c3069cc17eb05b7746`, S1-D `06c1213149e4649c62dcb6133669dec90cd4d29f`, Q2/S1-E `8b51dc8f1dd5bb622dda8bad3b11f6c5d703da94`, S2-B/C/D sourcefree accepted are **reusable bounded code**, not source use grants. The sourcefree 309/150/330 operation census and 100k events/one respondent are **not** original35.
PP26 source/claim law: retain RAW observed-response when source/applicability provable without forcing absent optional weights; population inference needs design/weight/estimand, temporal requires comparability, causal requires further proof. Do not silently turn 4,705 routing-unknown historical RAW into eligible population denominators, do not invent source instruments from label strings.

## Immediate finite competent owner action (GO)
On the **existing authenticated original source host**, inventory only source **metadata and permission proofs** already legally available, not raw respondent data by default. For each of the 35 exact roster IDs record current immutable source edition/hash custody (or MISSING), actual host, permitted purpose/scope/retention, source permission authority and expiry/revocation, instrument/codebook & administration/routing known/UNKNOWN, respondent universe, response/weight/design semantics and issuer competence. Preserve exact prior historical authorization separately. **NO new paid data source/new web scraping/no uploading respondent bytes to GitHub.** Do not compile 35 invented unit fates. Output one 35-row typed decision register: `AUTHORIZED_FOR_THIS_HOST_PURPOSE`, `DENIED`, `EXPIRED`, `NOT_LOCATED`, `UNKNOWN_OWNER_DECISION`, with minimal exact missing competent actor/proof; not thirty-five new issues.
For every genuinely AUTHORIZED source, and ONLY there, execute an **actual source-positive native original S01/S02 selected-column/decoder/projection plus U/Epre claim-graded operation** through the correct accepted code/physical reader where compatible. Source document value/routing/missingness/recurring occurrence→eligible RAW/weight scientific fate→actual persisted I02 / first I03 native fact and changed/restored test where permitted. No fake respondent identifiers or private raw data in public receipts. Assert qualified source hash, source opens, semantic outputs/typed negatives at first reader, per-source claim gate, independent receipt and exact source rights.
If none is authorized, stop with `NATIVE_SOURCE_ISSUER_HOLD` and the precise **35×right** matrix (existing source owner decisions not guessed), plus exact **one highest-impact grant** the user/competent source steward must provide to unlock a real first source reader. This is a completed authority disposition, **not a scientific sourcefree green** and not a mandate to retry same inventory endlessly. If permitted actual subset positive, issue `NATIVE_SOURCE_SCOPED@EXACT_SOURCE_IDS`; full original35 claim only after all35 individually competently granted and executed. Control-run independent nonauthor first reader for any source-native positive; never use Browser model textual reconstruction as runtime proof.

## No-conflict / closure
Source native writes must use **source-owner isolated worktrees** and source-local private paths; Browser #997 bridge and Codex #998 product/integration code READONLY. Do not edit accepted S2-C/D physical writer or math/science and no new issuer. Reuse existing original-grade approval, no invented rights. G1–G5 source-native positive only if license/current issuer and actual native consumer; else exact RIGHTS_HOLD, freeze. Original N11/N12/Field Forge structural and actor issuer are not part of S01/S02 first-read action. Send finite execution/authorization output to #918/#909/#960 and dependent #998 without exposing sensitive data.
